transform_notes: SAP's own key is PERNR (Personnel Number). Keep Employee_ID only as a migration cross-reference attribute, e.g. in a custom infotype or an external mapping table, not as a standard field.
Resolve via Foundation>Companies lookup (Company_ID -> T001-BUKRS) before load.
Resolve via HR>Departments Types lookup, which itself maps to HRP1000 org units -- a two-hop join.
Sections model a finer org level than Department; represented as a child org unit under the Department in the HRP1000/HRP1001 hierarchy, not a separate field.
Resolve via HR>Marital Status lookup into SAP's fixed FAMST domain values (married/single/divorced/...).
Resolve via HR>Salary Grades lookup, which maps to T510 (Pay Scale Groups).

SAP normally assigns PERNR internally on creation. Preserving legacy codes like 'EMP-0001' requires enabling external number assignment on the employee number range in the target system -- confirm with the Basis/config team before assuming a 1:1 carry-over.
Reformat ISO date string to SAP DATS (YYYYMMDD).
Map Male/Female/... text values to SAP's gender key domain (1/2/...).

Country-dependent infotype/subtype (e.g. a 'National ID' subtype for Jordan). A simpler fallback if IT0185 isn't configured is PA0002-PERID for one generic ID field -- confirm which the target system uses.
Map nationality/country text to SAP's nationality key (ISO-based).
Communication infotype subtype code for phone type varies by client configuration -- confirm the subtype catalog (cell vs. landline) in the target system.
Same infotype as phone but a different subtype -- confirm the e-mail subtype code configured in the target system.
Source is one free-text field; must be parsed and split into SAP's structured address fields. Good candidate for an AI-assisted parsing step given the free-text, multi-locale format.
Becomes the BEGDA (validity start) of the initial 'Hire' personnel action and the org assignment record it creates.
SAP models job title via Position (HRP1000 object type S) and/or Job (type C), not a free-text field -- requires building or matching an Org Management position catalog first.
Map Full-time/Part-time/Contract to configured employee subgroup values. 'Contract' may additionally need IT0016 (Contract Elements) for fixed-term contract data.
Derived from the latest personnel action record (PA0000) -- not stored as a standalone status field on the employee.
Becomes the BEGDA of a 'Leaving' personnel action; also drives the ENDDA (validity end) that delimits the employee's other infotype records.

transform_notes: Not a flat field on the employee record. SAP models 'manager' as a Position-to-Position (or Person-to-Position) relationship in Org Management. The flat self-referencing FK must be transformed into relationship edges, which requires the position catalog (see Job_Title) to exist first.

SAP stores an employee photo as an attached document via ArchiveLink, not a URL field. The image itself needs uploading/linking; the URL string can only be kept as a custom (Z) attribute if you don't migrate the actual photo.

transform_notes: No canonical free-text infotype for general HR notes. Carry as a custom infotype/text object, or drop if not business-critical -- confirm with the business owner before migrating unstructured free text.
Every infotype record automatically stamps its own creation timestamp on save (technical header) -- this is not loaded as source data.
SAP tracks field-level changes via change documents (CDHDR/CDPOS) automatically -- not loaded as source data.
Captured automatically as the SAP user who creates the record. The legacy creator ID can be retained only as a migration audit/cross-reference attribute, not loaded into a standard field.
